mainImage.alt: Secret Service agents with guns drawn rushing to protect and evacuate President Donald Trump at the White House Correspondents' Dinner as guests look on in the background
mainImage.caption: Secret Service agents rush President Donald Trump off stage after shots were fired outside the ballroom at the White House Correspondents' Association dinner at the Washington Hilton on April 25, 2026. Trump was escorted to safety within seconds of the first shot, with Vice President JD Vance and multiple Cabinet members also evacuated.
